label: Development test set. Synthetic passages only. Not a legal benchmark.

passages.text: Northwind delivered oak timber twelve days after the contractual date and the buyer withheld payment.
Section 14 of the fictional Example Evidence Act says a business record may be admitted when the witness is unavailable.
The tribunal declined jurisdiction because the arbitration clause required proceedings in Oslo.
Damages for late timber were the difference between the contract price and the market price on the delivery date.
The officer recorded the interview at 09:40 and offered a break every hour.
Costs follow the event unless the court orders otherwise in this synthetic judgment.
The lease prohibited subletting without prior written consent of the landlord.
A witness is unavailable if the witness cannot be found after a reasonable search.
